steps_basic.title: Random secret
steps_basic.instruction: Set secret to pick random 1 to 10.
steps_basic.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
set [secret v] to (pick random (1) to (10))

steps_basic.title: Ask guess
steps_basic.instruction: Ask 'Guess 1 to 10' and set guess to answer.
steps_basic.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
set [secret v] to (pick random (1) to (10))
ask [Guess 1 to 10] and wait
set [guess v] to (answer)

steps_basic.title: Check answer
steps_basic.instruction: If guess=secret say Correct, else check high/low.
steps_basic.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
set [secret v] to (pick random (1) to (10))
ask [Guess 1 to 10] and wait
set [guess v] to (answer)
if <(guess) = (secret)> then
  say [Correct!] for (2) seconds
else
  if <(guess) > (secret)> then
    say [Too high!] for (2) seconds
  else
    say [Too low!] for (2) seconds

steps_standard.title: Make tries
steps_standard.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
set [secret v] to (pick random (1) to (10))
set [tries v] to (5)

steps_standard.title: Repeat loop
steps_standard.instruction: Wrap ask+check in 'repeat until tries=0 OR guess=secret'.
steps_standard.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
set [secret v] to (pick random (1) to (10))
set [tries v] to (5)
repeat until <<(tries) = (0)> or <(guess) = (secret)>>
  ask [Guess 1 to 10] and wait
  set [guess v] to (answer)
  if <(guess) = (secret)> then
    say [Correct!] for (2) seconds
  else
    if <(guess) > (secret)> then
      say [Too high!] for (2) seconds
    else
      say [Too low!] for (2) seconds
    change [tries v] by (-1)

steps_standard.title: Win/lose
steps_standard.instruction: After loop: if guess=secret say Win, else say Game over.
steps_standard.blocks_text:
after repeat:
if <(guess) = (secret)> then
  say [You win!] for (2) seconds
else
  say (join [Game over. Secret was ] (secret)) for (3) seconds

steps_advanced.title: Difficulty
steps_advanced.instruction: Make 'maxNum' variable. Ask difficulty, set maxNum to 10/50/100.
steps_advanced.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
ask [easy, medium, or hard?] and wait
if <(answer) = [easy]> then
  set [maxNum v] to (10)
if <(answer) = [medium]> then
  set [maxNum v] to (50)
if <(answer) = [hard]> then
  set [maxNum v] to (100)

steps_advanced.title: Use maxNum
steps_advanced.instruction: Change secret to pick random 1 to maxNum.

steps_advanced.title: Even/odd hint
steps_advanced.instruction: When tries=2, say if secret is EVEN or ODD.
steps_advanced.blocks_text:
inside repeat loop:
if <(tries) = (2)> then
  if <((secret) mod (2)) = (0)> then
    say [Hint: EVEN!] for (2) seconds
  else
    say [Hint: ODD!] for (2) seconds

steps_advanced.title: Best score
steps_advanced.instruction: Make bestScore variable. When win, calculate guesses and update if better.
steps_advanced.blocks_text:
when win:
set [guesses v] to ((5) - (tries) + (1))
if <(guesses) < (bestScore)> then
  set [bestScore v] to (guesses)
